chapter_title: Concerning the Seed Grain that shall be formed by
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** These interior truths — both the germinal truth of good and the germinal truth of use that you perceive — shall be organized and [GAP-1: brought forth into spiritual form] and perfected by the five essential faculties of the spiritual mind. Now, the ardor of love and the clarity of understanding together sustain the germinal truth and the whole perception that grows from it. So, just as these capacities nourish it [GAP-2: and cause it to flourish in the mind], it is laid waste [GAP-3: and its life withdrawn] through [GAP-4: the deprivation of all good and truth, which is] spiritual desolation.

**¶3:** In this same way, the good of life from truth draws all five faculties of the spiritual mind into conjunction with itself.

**¶4:** In this same way also, a spiritual deficiency and deprivation shall pass from one state of the mind to another through these faculties; and those who have willed and received these truths have appropriated them inwardly and brought them to perfection and made them their own, while a state of tribulation shall arise on account of those who have not.

**¶5:** Human minds also shall be led into falsity and evil on their account, through the active force of the natural-corporeal proprium that inheres in them. It has cast the obscurity of its falsity over them, just as it shall also cast its obscurity over the essential spiritual faculties themselves and annihilate the good works that proceed from all perceptions of truth.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: “This seed grain and this barley grain that you see shall be formed and [brought forth] and beautified by the five elements. Now, the warmth and the cold nourish the seed grain and the entire tree. So, just as these things nourish it [and cause it to grow] it is destroyed [and its life is taken] through [thirst and] hunger.
“In this way also righteousness gathers the five to it.

“In this way too, a lack and a shortfall shall occur from place to place through them; and they who have chosen it have gathered it in and beautified and attained it, while an affliction shall arise for it through those.

“People also shall be caused to stumble on their account, through the energy of Matter that dwells in them. It has poured its shadow over them, just as it shall also pour its shadow over the elements and destroy the fruits of all the trees.”

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading gives "brought forth into spiritual form" for this position; in the Kephalaia's natural-agricultural register, "brought forth" completes the developmental triad "formed and brought forth and beautified" — initial shaping, emergence into manifest form, and final perfection.

The spiritual reading says "and cause it to flourish in the mind"; in the agricultural register of the Kephalaia, the natural expression for the positive outcome of nourishment upon a seed and tree is "cause it to grow," completing the contrast with the destruction that follows.

The spiritual reading gives "and its life withdrawn" for this position; in the natural register of the Kephalaia, the seed's destruction is paired with the withdrawal of its vital force — "its life is taken" expresses the removal of the animating principle that the elements had sustained.

The spiritual reading gives "the deprivation of all good and truth, which is" before "hunger/desolation"; in Manichaean cosmological idiom, "thirst and hunger" is the standard paired expression for total elemental deprivation — thirst corresponds to deprivation of truth (water/cold/understanding) and hunger to deprivation of good (warmth/love).
